summary:
CWE-606: the bad() servlet reads the "name" request parameter, parses it to an int, and uses it directly as a loop upper bound without range-checking. A large or negative value lets an attacker drive an excessive iteration count (resource exhaustion). The fix clamps the parsed count into a bounded range before the loop: negatives become zero and values above a generous maximum are capped, while legitimate small positive counts loop exactly as requested so the feature is preserved. Only the editable servlet source is changed.</parameter>
